officialFindings.finding: errSecMissingEntitlement means a required entitlement is missing; keychain access groups are determined by signed app entitlements.
Apple identifies keychain-access-groups as a restricted entitlement requiring a provisioning profile.
PKCS#12 is password-protected private-key transport; this recovery does not create or retain such a file because it would violate the no-private-material-outside-Keychain constraint.

attempts.method: ad-hoc-signed sandboxed local helper with one application-group entitlement

attempts.reason: Apple documents private-key import as PKCS#12 password-protected transport. Creating a PKCS#12 import path would require a private-key container/password outside Keychain, contrary to this assigned no-export/no-temp/no-user-secret boundary.

requiredSupportedInput: A user-provided, properly provisioned macOS signing helper identity (Apple Developer team signing certificate plus provisioning profile that authorizes its keychain access group), or an already-authorized local signing app/keychain authority. No paid service is assumed, but this host does not expose either credential or authorization.
